name: Punch split
summary: Fast, punctuated split-screen cards with one icon per claim; each scene enters on a short eased push that finishes before the new content appears.

forbidden: bounce, elastic or back overshoot on any entrance (R1)
decorative loops or breathing scale on icons (R4)
a hard camera snap at a scene boundary; each scene change is one eased push (R3, Pilot 001 snapped at four scene cuts)

frame_checklist: Each side of the split carries one idea, not two
The icon and its caption are both readable at phone size
The bold claim line is six words or fewer (R6)
The split edge does not cut through any text (R5)
The push completes and holds before the next scene's content appears (R3)
